explication: PaintsUndo turns an input artwork into a simulated drawing history: the interface obtains WD14 tags, generates several single-frame keyframes, then interpolates between them with the multi-frame video model. The graph preserves both model families and the multi-frame architecture documented in the README. Some UI and model-loading code was only excerpted; edges reflect README statements or source references, and uncertain internal calls are omitted.
